# AIS-OPS-01

**Are token, rate, cost and time limits set on every model call?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | OPS: Running AI |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.limits` |

## Rule

Every ai facet has limits with budget and timeout. Where model.hosting is managed-platform and the platform sets call limits the team cannot, limits.budget and a decision accepting the platform's limits meet this criterion instead.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026, LLM06 Unbounded Consumption (`owasp-llm06`)
- AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens (`wa-aws-genai`)
